title: Busta Rhymes Tells Fan He'll  'F**' His Girl After She Tried To Violate Him [Watch]
htmlContent:
A Busta Rhymes fan went a little too far in his "Touch It" song.

The rapper of "Put Your Hands Where My Eyes Could See" became viral through the trendy videos of him hitting one of the hands of a fan during a recent show. And after furiously scolding the fan-girl, the Brooklyn native harshly warned her boyfriend, “I’ll f*** your girl.”

“Stop the music,” the rapper yelled in the middle of performing. 

Ayo, shorty, you’re with your man, right?” he asked the unnamed woman whose wrist he’d swatted. She and her date were standing front row at the stage’s edge, but before she could answer, Rhymes diverted his attention to her boyfriend, asking him, “That’s your girl? What kinda s*** are you on that you’re gonna let her continue to grab me up?”

“See, I’m a grown man. I’ll f*** your girl, bro. I don’t want to f*** your girl,” he said as folks in the audience gawked. “Tame your girl.”

He would later say that we are in weird times in 2022.

“This is a weird day, a weird time,” he asserted. “She touched me and s***, y’all got them little funny ass camera phones filming, and I don’t agree with that. She might do some police s***. I’m not with it.”

Adding, “She ain’t from my day. In my time, we didn’t f*** with all these cameras, homie...Take your girl and tell her to stand behind you.”
